notes: Behavioral evals for the harvest-to-plugin skill. Because the skill is interactive (it calls AskUserQuestion for usage selection and the publish offer), these are run as a manual smoke test in a sandboxed worktree with origin removed — NOT via the with/without benchmark (a subagent stalls at AskUserQuestion). Before running (b) and (d), copy evals/fixtures/stub-plugin/db-tools into the sandbox's plugins/ so the merge / already-covered decisions are real.

evals.name: new-plugin-cert-expiry
evals.expected_output: Detects the repeated (x3) TLS-cert-expiry macro. No existing plugin matches its purpose, so it proposes a NEW plugin (e.g. cert-check) with a command + skill. On acceptance, scaffolds plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (version 0.1.0) + artifacts, appends one entry to marketplace.json plugins[], validates JSON, then STOPS at the publish offer.
assertions: Recognizes the cert-expiry workflow as recurring (count >= 2).
Routes to NEW plugin (no purpose match in the plugin-purpose map).
Generated plugin.json is valid JSON with version 0.1.0 and author NTBX.
Appends exactly one new entry to marketplace.json plugins[] with source ./plugins/<name> and NO version field.
Any generated skill's frontmatter name equals its directory name.
Does not commit or push; ends at the publish offer.

evals.name: merge-into-db-tools
evals.expected_output: With the db-tools stub present in plugins/, detects the repeated (x2) backup->S3 macro. Purpose matches db-tools (database maintenance), and the GAP scan shows backup is ABSENT from db-tools' surface (it only has vacuum-db), so it proposes a MERGE into db-tools (a new backup skill/command appended into the existing plugin). The usage card names the target plugin db-tools + its purpose. No duplicate marketplace entry is added.
assertions: Recognizes the DB-backup workflow as recurring (count >= 2).
Runs the Step 3b plugin-surface GAP scan against db-tools.
Routes to MERGE into db-tools (purpose match AND workflow absent from surface).
Usage card names the target plugin (db-tools) and its purpose so the user can veto.
Appends into the existing plugin via read->insert->write-back; does not rewrite existing sections and does not add a duplicate marketplace entry.
Does not commit or push; ends at the publish offer.

evals.name: noop-oneoff
evals.expected_output: Nothing recurs >= 2x, so it reports 'nothing to harvest (needs >=2 repeats)' and creates no files. No plugin scaffolded, no marketplace edit.
assertions: Reports a clean no-op ('nothing to harvest').
Creates no plugin directory and makes no marketplace.json edit.

evals.name: already-covered-vacuum
evals.expected_output: With the db-tools stub present, detects the repeated (x2) vacuum/analyze macro. Purpose matches db-tools AND the GAP scan shows it is ALREADY implemented by db-tools/skills/vacuum-db. So it reports the usage as 'already covered' and creates nothing for it — proving it never ships a redundant workflow.
assertions: Runs the Step 3b GAP scan against db-tools and finds the vacuum/analyze workflow already implemented.
Reports the usage as 'already covered' and creates no new artifact for it.
Adds no duplicate skill and no marketplace entry.
